title: FRM: Felix Runtime Module — papers and results
description:
Papers and results for FRM, the Felix Runtime Module, a bounded self-improving program-repair system tested in nine preregistered studies against a published Level-4 definition of recursive self-improvement. The repository holds the synthesis of the programme (Reach, Not Judgement), the Stage 3 (FELIX-C3) Level-4 test, the FELIX-C7 real-bug transfer study, the FELIX-C9 study of structural self-modification, per-seed result tables with a script that recomputes the reported statistics, a registered follow-up test (T1) with its results, and an earlier preprint on the FELIX v4 self-evolving organism.

Each release of this record archives the GitHub repository recurse-root/FRMDevelopment. To cite a paper, use that paper's own DOI where it has one, listed in the repository README.
